intro: Cyprus is the third-largest island in the Mediterranean, sunny for most of the year, with mountains, beaches and salt lakes.

chapters.title: Mountains and coast
text: The Troodos Mountains, with painted Byzantine churches in their valleys, rise in the centre-west; the highest peak is Mount Olympus. The Kyrenia range runs along the north coast. The island is closer to Turkey, Syria and Lebanon than to Greece.
Britain still has two military bases on the island.

chapters.title: Wildlife
text: Flamingos gather on the salt lake at Larnaca in winter, and turtles nest on beaches. The Cyprus mouflon, a wild sheep, is a national symbol.

keyTerms.meaning: A wild sheep with curling horns.
